trigger: Phase1 found initial-generation fraction84..87% in labeled training versus34% runtime. Code samples first with probability1/2 and later1/32. This is a sampling-design correction, not a test-outcome filter.
target_population: The existing neutral-reference delayed eligible opportunities, reweighted for known independent hash inclusion only. No correction for unreached probes, latent missing states, or policy-dependent runtime generations is claimed.
weights: First-generation weight2, later32. Normalize training weights to mean1. All test metrics and controls use the same raw inclusion weights. Actual row n and effective n reported; sum of weights is not an observed count.

arms.IPW_RAW_DIRECT: Weighted raw-feature POST and direct POST-minus-WAIT LightGBM, pinned parameters/rounds.
arms.IPW_COMPACT_DIRECT: Identical phase1 training-fitted compact preprocessing, weighted POST and timing LightGBM, pinned parameters/rounds.

controls: Reevaluate saved FROZEN_V2, RAW_DIRECT, COMPACT_DIRECT, COMPACT_RIDGE predictions on identical weighted test rows. Exact action/target identity reconciliation. Prior-training weighted mean and fixed rung/price-bin weighted mean baselines.
null: 500 draws, match day/side/hour/rung/initial-generation status and selected count. Within each stratum weight is constant, so selected weight mass also matches exactly. Uniform k-subsets. Require >=30 selected/unselected rows and >=30 selected effective n; positive weighted absolute POST and weighted timing advantage above0 and nullp95.
constraints: Raw labels retained. No clipping outcomes, test-fitting, no outcome-selected rows, no tuning. All five consumed test dates and all six arms reported. No new portfolio/forward claim.
checks: Five tests: correct inverse probabilities and invalid generation refusals; weighted metrics/oracle/anti/invalid weights; known population recovered under artificial sampling; weighted null oracle/anti/wrong-weight/undersampled refusals; timing advantage cannot override negative absolute entry value.
execution: Own core8 via supervised run_light. Current size worker completes, parent yields, finally and ExecStopPost resume. Failed namespaces preserved.
